title: Evaluating Biased Attitude Associations of Language Models in an Intersectional Context

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the valence association of the contextualized representation of the word 'person' using SC-WEAT (Single Context Word Embedding Association Test) when placed in intersectional sentence templates containing age descriptors (e.g., young vs. old).
